verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official, first-party MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, and a probe confirms the documentation page exists at docs.stripe.com/mcp. The evidence is thin on detail: it is a single summary line plus a probe. missing for 10: documentation of Billing-specific MCP tools (subscriptions, invoices, meters), connection/auth setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can drive Billing workflows through the server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
